scope: Twelve wrappingU32 predicated/multi-consumer recipes and six archived ABI-regression anchors. Six discovery and six preset held-out callback instantiations are not an external corpus. Anchors copy exact round14 arrays/scalars/results. Same external cost model applies to prior/current candidates. Full calls include one input snapshot, Wasm copy/result conversion, await and checksum. Borrowed checked/expertJS excludes snapshots equally and is reported separately. Original controls retain eager source stages; expert controls fuse traversal with independent accumulators when appropriate. Native Rust uses identical source; resident/snapshot kernels separately timed. ActualGPU counters cover uploads/dispatches/readback; fallbacks never timed asGPU. No synthetic repetitions, F32 reassociation, native memory measurement or general language superiority claim.
